commitResults.messageTitle: Level-0: Rename Duke, add greeting and exit
commitResults.messageBody:
The template ships with a bare Duke class that only prints the setup banner and has no chatbot behavior yet.

Level-0 requires customizing the chatbot's name and giving it a basic greet/exit interaction.

The main class is renamed from Duke to Verity, prints a startup greeting, and exits with a farewell msg.
